<parameter=code>
def state(f):
    Y=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y':
            rows=sorted(set(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])); cols=sorted(set(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
            if rows[0]>5: Y.append((n['pixels'],rows[0],rows[-1],cols[0],cols[-1]))
    return Y
seq = [(33,32),(32,32),(33,31)]
for r,c in seq:
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(f"click ({r},{c}) -> Y:",state(current_frame),"step:",current_frame.step,"level:",current_frame.level)
    if res and (res.get('game_over') or res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('run_complete')):
        print("STOP:", res); break
    if current_frame.level!=2: print("LEVEL CHANGED"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
